# numpy 1.26.4 → 2.4.6

Upgrade NumPy from 1.26.4 to 2.4.6. All 26 baseline tests pass.

### Changes

| File | Change | Source |
|------|--------|--------|
| requirements.txt | `numpy>=1.11.2` → `numpy>=2,<3` | pin |
| setup.py | `'numpy >= 1.11.2'` → `'numpy>=2,<3'` | pin |
| nsopy/methods/bundle.py | `-np.infty` → `-np.inf` (2 occurrences) | |
| nsopy/methods/quasi_monotone.py | `-np.infty` → `-np.inf` (2 occurrences) | |
| nsopy/methods/quasi_monotone.py | trailing newline added | |

### Verification

- ✅ 26/26 baseline tests pass
- ✅ numpy 2.4.6 installed
- ✅ upgrade pin kept in manifests
- ✅ no module shadows `numpy`
- ✅ no test files edited
- ✅ test count stable at 33
- ✅ no newly skipped tests
- ✅ no errors suppressed (warnings only)

### Notes

- The `-np.infty` → `-np.inf` replacements fix deprecation warnings in NumPy 2.x.
- `setup.py` pin format adjusted to match `requirements.txt` style.
